tasks.message: No Link headers found on target page
tasks.title: Include Link response headers for agent discovery (RFC 8288)
tasks.prompt: Add Link response headers to your homepage that point agents to useful resources. For example: Link: </.well-known/api-catalog>; rel="api-catalog" to advertise your API catalog, or Link: </docs/api>; rel="service-doc" for API documentation. See RFC 8288 for the Link header format and IANA Link Relations for registered relation types.

tasks.title: Publish /robots.txt with clear crawl rules
tasks.prompt: Create /robots.txt at the site root with explicit User-agent directives and allow/disallow rules for key paths. Ensure it is plain text and returns 200.

tasks.title: Publish a sitemap and reference it from robots.txt
tasks.prompt: Generate /sitemap.xml listing canonical URLs, keep it updated on publish, and reference it from /robots.txt.

tasks.message: Site does not support Markdown for Agents
tasks.title: Support Accept: text/markdown content negotiation for machine-readable content
tasks.prompt: Enable Markdown for Agents so requests with Accept: text/markdown return a markdown version of your HTML.

tasks.message: DNS for AI Discovery (DNS-AID) well-known entrypoint records not found
tasks.title: Publish DNS for AI Discovery (DNS-AID) SVCB/HTTPS records for DNS-based agent discovery
tasks.prompt: Publish DNS for AI Discovery (DNS-AID) ServiceMode SVCB or HTTPS records under _agents with DNSSEC validation enabled.

tasks.message: Cannot check Content Signals without robots.txt
tasks.title: Declare AI content usage preferences with Content Signals in robots.txt
tasks.prompt: Add Content-Signal directives to your robots.txt declaring preferences for ai-train, search, and ai-input.

tasks.message: Cannot check AI rules without robots.txt
tasks.title: Add User-agent rules for AI crawlers like GPTBot, Claude-Web, and others
tasks.prompt: Add explicit User-agent entries for AI crawlers (GPTBot, Claude-Web, Google-Extended) with allow/disallow rules.

tasks.title: Publish an A2A Agent Card for agent-to-agent discovery
tasks.prompt: Serve an A2A Agent Card at /.well-known/agent-card.json with your agent name, version, supported interfaces, capabilities, and skills.

tasks.title: Publish an agent skills discovery index
tasks.prompt: Publish a skills index at /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json listing skill names, types, descriptions, URLs, and digests.

tasks.title: Publish an API catalog for automated API discovery (RFC 9727)
tasks.prompt: Create /.well-known/api-catalog returning application/linkset+json with a "linkset" array listing your APIs and their specs.

tasks.title: Publish an ARD (Agentic Resource Discovery) manifest so agents can discover your site's capabilities (MCP servers, A2A agents, OpenAPI schemas, and more)
tasks.prompt: Serve /.well-known/ai-catalog.json with specVersion, host, and an entries array listing your MCP servers, agents, and skills.

tasks.title: Publish Auth.md metadata for agent registration
tasks.prompt: Serve /auth.md and advertise agent_auth in OAuth Authorization Server metadata so agents can register securely.

tasks.title: Publish an MCP Server Card for agent discovery
tasks.prompt: Serve an MCP Server Card (SEP-1649) at /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json with serverInfo, transport endpoint, and capabilities.

tasks.title: Publish OAuth/OIDC discovery metadata so agents can authenticate with your APIs
tasks.prompt: If your site has protected APIs, publish /.well-known/openid-configuration or /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server with your auth server metadata.

tasks.message: No OAuth Protected Resource Metadata found
tasks.title: Publish OAuth Protected Resource Metadata so agents can discover how to authenticate
tasks.prompt: Publish /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource with your resource identifier and authorization_servers so agents can discover how to authenticate.

tasks.message: No WebMCP tools detected on page load
tasks.title: Support WebMCP to expose site tools to AI agents via the browser
tasks.prompt: Implement the WebMCP API by calling navigator.modelContext.registerTool() for each tool that exposes your site's key actions to AI agents.
